exposure: unengaged fetal head at term in labor
outcome: mode of delivery (vaginal vs. Cesarean section)
cohort: 150 term primigravida women with an unengaged head in labor
finding: In primigravida with an unengaged fetal head at term gestation at the onset of labor, vaginal delivery is possible with watchful expectancy and appropriate intervention.
mod_finding: Out of the 57 patients induced, 25 (43.86%) had vaginal deliveries, while 32 (56.14%) underwent Lower Segment Cesarean Section.
